children: Topp announced it expects to reincorporate from Nevada to Delaware under a plan of conversion, effective about Sept. 25, 2026.
Board and stockholders approved plan; reincorporation effective on or about Sept. 25, 2026 subject to state filings.
Company will convert into a Delaware corporation; governance will shift to Delaware law and new certificate/bylaws.
Each existing common share will convert 1-for-1 into Delaware shares with no action required by holders.
Authorized common shares to increase from 300,000,000 to 1,000,000,000; no immediate issuance of additional shares.
Reincorporation expected to not affect HQ, operations, management, trading symbol TOPP, or cause trading interruption.
